Package game.status

Class IncapacitatingStatus

java.lang.Object
game.status.TimedStatus
game.status.IncapacitatingStatus
All Implemented Interfaces:
Status
Direct Known Subclasses:
StunnedStatus
public abstract class IncapacitatingStatus extends TimedStatus
A TimedStatus that, while active, prevents the Actor carrying it from acting on their turn.

This is a pure type marker: it adds no methods of its own. It exists so that ConsciousActor can ask "does this actor have any status that stops them acting right now" with a single hasStatus(IncapacitatingStatus.class) check, without needing to know about every concrete incapacitating status (Stunned, and eventually Trapped) individually. Each subclass only needs to say how long it lasts and, via TimedStatus's applyEffect(), what its own per-turn effect (if any) is on top of the inability to act.
